# Welcome

This course template standardizes learning objectives, prerequisites, session
structure, practice, assessment and instructor notes. Replace the demonstration
with your own reviewed teaching material.

Start with the [syllabus](syllabus.qmd), work through the
[example lesson](lessons/01-evidence.qmd), and complete the
[practice task](exercises/01-practice.qmd).

The demonstration uses synthetic values and requires no software beyond a
browser or a text editor. State the actual prerequisites of your own course
before distributing it.
